title: Aoyagi Toya — Popping Puyos At Lightspeed〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Arcade

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So this is where the gaming tournament's supposed to take place.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And it's cleaner than I expected. I guess it really is their grand reopening.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, with quite a selection of machines and new titles.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, how do we actually register for this tournament?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
The registration for that should be...
Oh, there it is.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Excuse me. We'd like to register for the “Funtastic Gaming Tournament” that we saw being advertised on this flyer...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
You'd like to enter?! Excellent!
Just fill out the parts that say, “Required,” if you will!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: The tournament will be starting soon, so you'll need to be quick!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Our names, team name, favorite games, list of tournaments we've been in... I'm surprised at how legit this looks...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, can you handle this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure, no problem.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That should be everything, so now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not sure what to do about our team name. Do you have any good suggestions?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hmm... Our team name...
Why not just “BAD DOGS”?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It isn't a bad suggestion, but I'd rather not cheapen it by using it here...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, this is a gaming tournament and not a singing event. This doesn't seem like the right time or place for it, so let's think of something else.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The right time and place, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. With that in mind, we should try coming up with a name that suits us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: In that case, we could try putting our initials together...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We have S and A... A and T...
Take out the duplicate A and go with SAT...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Isn't that what the police's special tactical unit's called?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... You might be right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hmm... A good team name...
Do you have any preferences or suggestions, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, it'd be nice if it captured who we are...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Who we are? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm not actually too sure myself...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's give it a little more thought and just go with our initial if all else fails...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Since the two of us are entering together, it'd be nice to come up with a name that fits us perfectly...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (In that respect, drawing upon our real names does seem like a good option...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Our real names...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, do you remember when we all came up with a player name for me?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, you mean when the four of us went to that arcade together?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. That time, we...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is my first time hearing that you have to come up with a player name for yourself. Despite having been to the arcade many times, I honestly had no idea.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's not really your fault since you almost exclusively play the claw machines.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, claw machines are big and usually right by the entrance, so it's kind of hard to see all the other games that are further in...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it seems pretty natural to not know based on what you usually like to do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: At the same time, I still sorta can't believe that you almost put in your real name.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. I'm glad that you were all there to warn me that I should be using a pseudonym instead.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, if you don't mind or if worst comes to worst, there's nothing wrong with using your real name.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, everybody else was using a pseudonym so... When in Rome...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so you, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Isn't it?
Also, I think the name we came up with is pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. There's a chance that someone else has the same initials as me, so we added the initials for our team name at the end to make...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ATVBS... Read as “at-bis”.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's really just a string of initials.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But I think it's a cool name.
I'd like to wear this name proudly as I play moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You all helped come up with a name for me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, you wanna do the same thing for our team name?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That could work, but I'm thinking that we could use a pair of words this time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Aoyagi and Shinonome... A willow and a cloud... Yes, we can be Willow & Cloud.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Willow & Cloud...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, not bad.
It's definitely better than just using our initials.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Excellent. Then, let's go with this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, let's do our absolute best today to win as Willow & Cloud.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...
